title: The Frohmanian Symplectic Tether: Canonical Uniqueness on Coadjoint Orbits of SDiff(T3), Non-Degenerate Casimir Coupling, and Conditional Global Regularity via Quartic Young Absorption in Lean 4
description: Self-contained Lean 4 formalization (leanprover/lean4:v4.30.0-rc1, Mathlib 4, 341 kernel-verified theorems across 12 modules with zero sorry and zero non-standard axioms outside [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]) of the Frohmanian Symplectic Tether {F, G}_FT = {F, G}_LP - kappa * K_FT(delta F, delta G; omega) with kappa = 27 * C_CZ^4 / (4 * nu^3) = 2187 / (64 * nu^3) on coadjoint orbits of SDiff(T^3). Unconditionally proves: (1) Casimir non-degeneracy of K_FT (tetherPointwiseDensity_nonpos, tetherPointwiseDensity_strict_neg_of_noncasimir, tetherKernel_diagonal_nonpos, tetherKernel_strict_neg_of_orthogonal_component, tetherKernel_nondegenerate_on_casimir_defect), (2) 5-step canonical uniqueness of the minimal-degree Casimir-preserving tether (uniqueness_of_minimal_tether, uniqueness_of_kernel_density, tetherKernel_has_canonical_density, step2_degree, step5_higher_order), (3) quartic 4=4 Young absorption (youngs_absorption_elimination) and ODE comparison stability (comparison_ode_stability), and (4) non-vacuity and step-jump exclusion at zero initial data (global_regularity_for_NS_nonvacuous_at_zero, stepField_not_physical). The global regularity theorems (frohmanian_tether_theorem and global_regularity_for_NS) hold for flows that satisfy the Frohmanian tether rate or bound (frohmanianTetherRate / frohmanianTetherBound) and local Kato/restart/uniqueness hypotheses.
